title: easel instance configuration (easel.toml)
description: The one TOML file at the instance root (<home>/easel.toml). Found in this order: --workspace, $EASEL_HOME, upward from the current folder, ~/.config/easel/. Any key can be overridden with EASEL_<SECTION>__<KEY>. `easel config set <section.key> <value>` validates against this schema and refuses an unknown key or a wrong type (exit 2, file unchanged). Absolute paths belong only in an instance copy, never in a shipped file.

schema.description: the format and its version; always the first key

name.description: a short name for this instance

adopted.description: true = an existing workspace the tool works beside through its own runner

paths.description: where the instance keeps its data. Relative paths are relative to the instance root; ${VAR} is expanded at load time. images_root (kiln, adopted projects only) is read-only until cutover

models_root.description: <models_root>: the folder that holds checkpoints/, loras/, ...

extra_model_roots.description: more folders laid out like <models_root> (ComfyUI can map several base paths), scanned after models_root; the first root that has a file name wins, and downloads always land in models_root

url.description: the ComfyUI server's base URL; ComfyUI's upstream default is http://127.0.0.1:8188

dir.description: <comfyui_dir>: only when the tool starts and stops the server itself

min_version.description: the oldest ComfyUI version the graphs are tested with

manage_lifecycle.description: true = the tool may start and stop the server

start_args.description: extra arguments when the tool starts the server; none by default

timeout_s.description: seconds to wait for one HTTP answer

limits.description: RAM needed per job comes from families/<f>.yaml host_ram_gb, not from here

host_ram_floor_gb.description: free host RAM never given away to a job

disk_floor_gb.description: free disk in GB that a download, a render or a write must leave; each instance sets its own

skip_ram_check.description: true = start jobs without measuring free RAM (only where it cannot be measured)

kind.description: none = wait for free RAM and disk locally; command = call the *_command templates

fail_open.description: true = run anyway when the scheduler cannot be reached (default false: fail closed)

stop_file.description: a file whose appearance asks a running job to yield

plan_command.description: a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped

ready_command.description: a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped

wait_command.description: a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped

start_command.description: a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped

check_command.description: a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped

requeue_command.description: a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped

done_command.description: a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped

cancel_command.description: a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped

update_command.description: a command template for this scheduler verb; written per machine, never shipped

allowed.description: the GPU verbs a scheduler may start for this instance; empty = none

bind.description: address the review page listens on

reviewer.description: who may look at images: only the person (default), or the assistant too for sfw images, its read labelled "assistant's read, not the verdict"

prompt_authoring.description: sfw-only = the assistant may write sfw prompt text; user-text-only = only the person's words go into prompts

unknown_rating_is.description: unknown content is never treated as sfw

second_source_name.description: the name verdicts and notes from the assistant are stored under

render.description: legacy-runner = an adopted workspace renders through its own runner; GPU verbs then refuse and point at the lines `recipe to-legacy` prints

subjects.description: subjects are fictional adults; prompts, captions and specs that make a subject read as a minor or depict a real person are refused

wordlist.description: your private word list, kept outside every repository; empty = none

extra_patterns.description: an optional file of extra scan patterns in the format of data/privacy/public-patterns.yaml (for example the id shapes of your own records), kept outside every repository; ${VAR} allowed; empty = none

search.description: search and download over the public Civitai API (/api/v1/, /api/download/) and the HF API

civitai_token_env.description: name of the environment variable that holds a Civitai API token (the token itself never goes into a file)

hf_token_env.description: name of the environment variable that holds a Hugging Face token

cache_hours.description: how long an API answer is reused

max_file_gb.description: `search vet` marks a larger file too-big

adopt.description: only on an adopted instance: host facts and the four command templates that `easel recipe to-legacy` renders (propose, dry-run, submit, status)

env_aliases.description: map an environment variable of your own setup to a key: "<OLD_NAME>" = "section.key"
